scenes.narration: Scholar Utility Belt adds journal quality badges beside each Google Scholar result.
Citation velocity shows how quickly each paper is being cited.
Retracted results carry a visible warning before you cite them.
Author profiles get h-index and g-index.
Lineage trees place an author among their advisors and students.
Rankings ship inside the extension. No account, no analytics.
Free core, open source. Add it to Chrome.

bumper.note: Purplelink LLC brand bumper at start and end; narration never overlaps the bumpers.
